He builds products end to end (APIs and microservices, Android and web apps, payments, AI features and cloud infrastructure) and is available for freelance projects.

## Experience

- Technology Lead, Yugam International School (LightTheChange Eduventure), 2026 to present. Leads the team building the school group's software and personally built its AI products.
- Freelance Product Engineer, 2026 to present. Clients include Neem Karoli Sales, Shikhar Classes and Gram Sansad.
- Product Engineer (Backend), Shuru Technologies, June 2024 to present. Built backend microservices for Pickup Coffee, cut API latency by 30% and set up OpenTelemetry tracing.
- Full Stack Web Developer, AFM Bigtech (Singapore, remote), September 2022 to June 2024. Built the backend for a JEE/NEET exam-prep LMS.
- Education: Full-Stack Web Development at Masai School (2021–2022). B.A. from Shekhawati University (2017–2020).

## Selected projects

- Neem Karoli Sales ordering platform: two Android apps (React Native/Expo) and a Fastify + MongoDB API for a Jaipur beverage wholesaler. Self-updating APKs, OTP sign-in, Cashfree payments, GST invoices, 1,290+ tests. https://neemkarolisales.in
- Yugam Ask: an AI agent that answers plain-English questions about 1.7M Indian schools using text-to-SQL, running on a self-hosted Qwen model on vLLM with a GPU that starts on demand.
- Face attendance: marks a class present from one photo using OpenCV YuNet + SFace on CPU, with no cloud AI.
- StreamFit: adaptive aptitude test and stream recommender for Class 10 students, built for Shikhar Classes. https://streamfit.shikharedtech.com
- Gram Sansad village platform: multi-tenant Next.js sites with automatic DNS and HTTPS for every village. https://gramsansad.com
- Yugam AI: lesson planner and Indian-language call transcription and summaries on a self-hosted server. https://ai.yugam.co
- Yugam International School website: Next.js with event passes, OTP sign-in and payments. https://yugam.co
